newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 12.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- About 430 billion CFA francs voted for public works and investment in Ivory Coast's 1997 draft budget presented to parliament on Tuesday.
- Reform of the United Nations a preoccupation of Ivorian Foreign Minister Amara Essy, one of four African candidates vying for post of U.N. secretary-general.
- Ivory Coast's state carrier Air Ivoire sees marked improvement in passenger traffic in recent days after a long run of falling sales, writes a correspondent in a special report.
- President Henri Konan Bedie is not showing enough support for the candidacy of his foreign minister Essy Amara for top U.N. job, opposition parliamentarian Ben Soumahoro says.
